apportionments.qualification: Designed allocation uses the separately dated year-end observation to split the July Finland projection. It is not a UN July independent estimate; both source measures remain unchanged.

semantics.execution: No runtime inventories, labor, capacity, purchasing power or needs are established by this artifact alone.
semantics.missing_areas: No separate WPP row exists for Antarctica, Bouvet, British Indian Ocean Territory, South Georgia/South Sandwich, French Southern Territories, Heard/McDonald, US Minor Outlying Islands or Pitcairn. A missing row is not observed zero. Pitcairn appears only in the Polynesia aggregate note; do not apportion a regional total silently.
semantics.politics: Geographic/statistical coverage and Designed gameplay markets are separate from jurisdiction, sovereignty, ownership and class.
semantics.population: WPP2024 medium projections are demographic context, not a census, labor force, household count or productive capacity. Derived integer conversion preserves raw XML tokens. The source year does not change the game membership snapshot date.
semantics.rounding: Preserve the four-person leaf-versus-world rounding residual. Do not force domestic ACS to the differently scoped UN US projection.
semantics.source_coverage: Country/Area rows only. All region, income, development and world aggregates remain non-additive controls. Included areas do not receive duplicate independent quantities. Missing independent observations stay blank; their known group subtotals do not claim complete coverage.
